data.cultural_impact: The significance of the name "Lughah" lies in its connection to the importance of language and communication in Islamic culture. In Islam, the Quran is considered to be the Word of God, revealed in Arabic language. The name emphasizes the importance of preserving and understanding the Quran and other religious texts in their original Arabic form. Moreover, during Islamic education and teaching, the word 'lughah' is often used to refer to Arabic lexical literature and Quranic and Hadith studies.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Lughah" reflects the belief in the divine origins of the Quran and the power of words in expressing and spreading God's message. In Islamic scripture, words and expressions are considered to hold great spiritual value. The name is a constant reminder of the significance of seeking knowledge and understanding of the divine revelations, and of the power of language in communicating and connecting with the divine.
